def place_on_zone_v3(obj_name, zone_name):
    # Observe the current state
    scene = observe()
    
    # Find grasp candidates for the object
    candidates = grasp_candidates(obj_name)
    if not candidates:
        raise RuntimeError(f"No grasp candidates found for {obj_name}")
    
    candidate = candidates[0]
    grasp_result = grasp(candidate)
    if not grasp_result["holding_something"]:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to grasp {obj_name}")
    
    # Check if the target zone has any occupants
    zone_spots = free_spots(zone_name)
    if zone_spots["occupants"]:
        # Move the occupant to a backup zone (e.g., purple_box) if available
        backup_zone = "purple_box"
        backup_spots = free_spots(backup_zone)
        if not backup_spots["spots"]:
            raise RuntimeError(f"No free spots on {backup_zone}")
        
        target_backup_spot = backup_spots["spots"][0]
        carry_to(target_backup_spot["x"], target_backup_spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=target_backup_spot["gripper_yaw"])
        lower_until_contact()
        open_gripper()
        retreat()
        check(zone_spots["occupants"][0], backup_zone)
    
    # Now ensure the target zone is free
    final_zone_spots = free_spots(zone_name)
    if not final_zone_spots["spots"]:
        raise RuntimeError(f"No free spots on {zone_name} after clearing")
    
    # Place the object on the first free spot of the target zone
    target_spot = final_zone_spots["spots"][0]
    carry_to(target_spot["x"], target_spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=target_spot["gripper_yaw"])
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat()
    check(obj_name, zone_name)
